Description: Two-level state machine per creature: the intent (WildlifeMind: roam, forage, drink, rest, sleep, alert, investigate, threaten, hunt, defend, flee, feed) and animation-timed actions inside it (Choreographer: notice, roar, startle, stalk, chase, bolt, look around, sniff, poop, settle, wake). Description: Tiers over creature levels: Common 1-20, Uncommon 21-40, Rare 41-60, Epic 61-80, Mythical 81-100, Primordial 100+. The tier is a label and a drop quality; stats stay on the level (LevelScaling). Creatures drop tiered parts, never finished gear: gear is crafted at the P14 benches, so recipe levels (F19) and the ages still decide what can be made, and the parts only decide its quality (output tier = the lowest tiered ingredient; only wild kills drop tiered parts). Quality scales durability (up to x3) more than stats (up to x1.5) and stays below the next material's Common (keratin armour 8 x1.5 = 12 < bronze 13); Rare and Epic get one capped affix, Mythical and Primordial two, from a small pool per item family; abilities stay on relics (F13). A tiered item works as Common until its holder reaches the tier's level (Ark's level-locked supply crates). Tooltips: the tier lives in a synced component arksurvivalreturns:quality, mirrored into minecraft:rarity (NeoForge-extensible enum: add Mythical, Primordial) and minecraft:tooltip_style (vanilla draws tooltip/<style>_frame and _background per stack; built like the Ark UI moss frame, animated by mcmeta). Obscure Tooltips: no 26.1 build (4.2.5 is 1.21.1, 5.0.0 is 1.21.11); its license forbids shipping a ported, patched or rebranded jar and reusing its code, so it can only ship unbranded from Modrinth once Obscuria releases 26.1, with an Ark style pack keyed on the rarities. Its nbt filter causes the detection failures: it compares the saved component patch with strict types (3 vs 3b), default components are absent, and unsynced components never reach the client. Apotheosis 26.1.2-9.0.3 exists but needs Apothic Enchanting and Spawners; only its idea is taken (rarity weights tied to an earned world tier).
Status: Under discussion (proposal 2026-09-30, Claude Opus 5.5). Decisions: 1) Mythical and Primordial sources: wild levels stop at 80 (Extreme 40-80) and clamp at 100, so proposed Mythical = rare alpha spawns in Severe/Extreme, Primordial = bosses and tames lifted past 100 by taming bonus levels (clamp raised); 2) skew the wild level roll toward the zone minimum (uniform makes half of Extreme Epic); 3) quality numbers, and steel's base at or above bronze Primordial (19.5); 4) the level each tier needs; 5) the affix pool; 6) which tier frames to draw.
